prompts.title: 电影级双色调光效下的 Blackpink Jennie 超写实肖像

prompts.content: Hyper-realistic, cinematic medium close-up portrait cropped at upper chest level, head and shoulders framing only, a stylish young Korean woman Blackpink Jennie in a cool side-profile pose, looking back over her shoulder. She has silver-white platinum blonde short wavy bob hair with tousled texture. She wears black oval sunglasses and a black leather biker jacket with collar turned up. One hand is raised, gripping the lapel near the chest, wearing delicate silver rings on fingers. The image features dramatic dual-tone studio lighting: an intense blue rim light outlining the back and shoulder from the left, contrasting with a warm red edge light highlighting the right side of the face and sunglasses. The background is pitch black, creating high contrast. Tight framing with no space below the chest, face and sunglasses as the primary focal point.
